board.description: The two 3D board PNGs and the two flat board SVGs in the README.
recipe: The script exports a board GLB with kicad-cli and renders it with Blender Cycles at 1600 samples.
If magick is on PATH, the script trims each PNG.
If you stage the PCB, the pre-commit hook runs these steps.
The KiCad 3D models are in c6remote-explode, so the fingerprint cannot see a change to them.

board-annotated.description: The labelled board SVGs. Each SVG embeds a PNG from the board group.
recipe: If you stage the PCB or a board PNG, the pre-commit hook runs these steps.

schematic.description: The schematic SVG in a light version and a dark version.
recipe: kicad-cli draws the symbol copies in the lib_symbols block of the schematic, so the symbol library files are not inputs.
If you stage the schematic, the pre-commit hook runs these steps.

case-stills.description: The case stills and the explode loop in the README. Blender renders them in c6remote-explode.
recipe: The renders read the case and board geometry that refresh-assets.sh copies into the assets/ set of the viewer.
case-assembled.png and the three case-annotated PNGs are 900 px wide. case-exploded.png is 1200 px wide. All five use 1600 samples from their presets.

case-annotated-front-white.png uses the readme-annotated-front preset with the white colorway, so the status LEDs glow through a white shell. The white colorway renders the shell with random-walk subsurface scattering, so the glow depends on the wall thickness.
render-case-explode-loop.sh writes a 720x540 WebP at 15 fps for 15.6 s and 256 samples for each frame.
Each render writes a dated file in c6remote-explode. The cp steps copy the newest dated file without a change.
The presets and the render scripts are in c6remote-explode, so the fingerprint cannot see a change to them.
After you refresh this group, refresh case-annotated and site-media too, because they read these files.

case-annotated.description: The labelled case SVGs. Each SVG embeds a case-annotated PNG from the case-stills group.
recipe: The pre-commit hook does not draw these SVGs, because ImageMagick can change the PNG bytes without a design change.

case-fronts.description: The SLS and FDM front face plans and the isometric clay renders of the two front shells, for case/README.md.
recipe: render-face-svg.py reads the case model directly. render-case-fronts-blender.py reads the STLs that case.py writes into case/export/.
The Blender script uses its defaults: 1200 px wide at 512 samples, with one camera for the two shells.

case-front-face.description: The front face plan on the web page. The firmware build embeds this file, so a stale copy ships in the firmware.
recipe: components/button_config/__init__.py embeds the file at build time. scripts/preview-buttons-page.py reads it for each request.
Keep the file small, because the firmware stores it in flash. After you refresh the file, build the firmware again.
web-page-shots reads this file, so refresh that group too.

web-page-shots.description: The two web page screenshots in the README. buttons-page-assign.png also feeds the site.
recipe: The fake remote in preview-buttons-page.py supplies the page state. The capture uses the Playwright copy in c6remote-explode/node_modules.
The capture uses a 1100x800 viewport, a device scale factor of 2, and the light colour scheme.
The assign view selects Button 7. The config view shows the Config tab down to the Import Export heading.
At baf4713 the outputs were 2200x1878 and 2200x3306 px. The config height follows the page.
After you refresh this group, refresh web-page-framed and site-media too, because they read these files.

web-page-framed.description: The two web page screenshots inside a drawn browser window, for the README.
recipe: browser-frame.sh needs ImageMagick. The default address in the frame is homething-c6-13f498.local.

site-media.description: The four feature clips and their posters, the explode video, and the web page crop on the C6 site page. The explode video's poster is case-exploded.png from case-stills.
recipe: The clips come from the demo video IMG_7480/IMG_7480_clicks.mp4 in the homeThingContent checkout. Git does not track that video, so the fingerprint cannot see it.
site-media.sh crops each clip to 1080x1440, scales it to 480x640, and encodes it as H.264 at CRF 26.
site-media.sh flattens case-explode-loop.webp onto white and encodes explode.mp4. The script reads the frame duration from the loop with webpmux.
explode.mp4 keeps the size and the frame timing of the loop.
feature-web-page.jpg is a 900x1020 crop of buttons-page-assign.png at 600 px wide and quality 82.
One run writes all ten files. With the d4e9f33 inputs, the script makes feature-web-page.jpg again byte for byte.

site-hero.description: The hero and preview image of the C6 site page: the C6 with lit status LEDs in front of a crowd of remotes.
recipe: The hero-banner-crowd preset sets 2880x1440 px, 1024 samples, and the LED glow. --jpeg 82 writes a quality 82 JPEG beside the dated PNG.
The preset ledColors list has one colour for each status LED, D2 to D7 in reference order. It must agree with readme-annotated-front.json.
The committed hero.jpg is the JPEG of the 2026-11-04T10-15-35-326Z render without a change. Its .png.log records the preset, the size, the samples, and the JPEG quality.
The preset is in c6remote-explode, so the fingerprint cannot see a change to it.

site-voice.description: The close-up of the mic sound hole on the Ask Home Assistant tile of the C6 site page.
recipe: The voice-mic-front preset shows the board alone, so the case model is not an input. refresh-assets.sh still needs the case STLs.
The render is 360x480 px at 512 samples on a transparent film. The magick step puts it on #141414 and writes a quality 82 JPEG.
The committed file is hero-drafts/voice/voice-mic-front-2026-11-01T21-32-00Z.jpg in c6remote-explode without a change.
The preset and the KiCad 3D models are in c6remote-explode, so the fingerprint cannot see a change to them.

photo-build-stages.description: A photo of the remote at each build stage. No script makes it.

logos-and-legacy.description: The homeThing logos and the images of the legacy site pages. No script in this repository makes them.
